_comment: Coverage ratchet baselines (#185), consumed by scripts/coverage_gate.py.
Measured on main's coverage job (MODE=cov, gcc-14 -O2, Linux x86_64 on the
git.geisten.net desktop runner, unit + int with the reference models; run
809, 2026-10-11): rounded down to whole percent, minus one point of
headroom (a single run). Raising after an improvement is routine; lowering
requires a justified, reviewed edit. null = not yet measured, which the
gate treats as a failure that prints the measured value.
Moving from arm64 to x86_64 lowered src/base (92 -> 49 line):
src/base/calibration.c is only reached through cpu_neon's and Metal's
tunables, which x86 has none of, so it is unmeasured here.
floors are hard minimums outside the ratchet. src/io is the malformed-GGUF
parser surface: test_io_malformed_unit drives both readers hermetically;
the floor sits just under what it reaches - raise it with the coverage,
do not let it drift down.
src/archs/vision_siglip is mostly unexercised by the unit + int suites
(13 %); the baseline only stops it from falling further.
